metadata.title: FeedCentral - Centralized News Aggregator
metadata.description: A professional RSS feed aggregator built with Next.js, offering a clean, Vercel-like interface to centralize and verify your news sources.

hero.title: Your News,
hero.subtitle: FeedCentral aggregates your trusted RSS sources into a clean, modern interface. Stay informed without the noise.

mission.title: Take Back Control of Your News Feed
mission.description1: In a world of algorithmic feeds and endless scrolling, FeedCentral brings you back to the basics:
mission.description1Highlight: curated, chronological content from sources you trust
mission.description2: We believe that staying informed shouldn't come at the cost of your privacy, attention, or sanity. FeedCentral is built with transparency, simplicity, and user respect at its core.

features.title: Everything You Need, Nothing You Don't
features.subtitle: FeedCentral combines powerful features with a clean, distraction-free experience

verifiedSources.title: Verified Sources
verifiedSources.description: Only reliable, curated RSS feeds from trusted publishers and established media outlets.

realtimeUpdates.title: Real-time Updates
realtimeUpdates.description: Automatic feed refresh keeps you up to date with breaking news and latest publications.

smartBookmarks.title: Smart Bookmarks
smartBookmarks.description: Save articles permanently with one click. Bookmarked content never expires.

powerfulSearch.title: Powerful Search
powerfulSearch.description: Full-text search across all articles with advanced filtering by source and category.

beautifulDesign.title: Beautiful Design
beautifulDesign.description: Clean, modern interface with dark mode support and responsive design for all devices.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.description: Fully transparent codebase. Fork it, self-host it, or contribute to make it better.

privacy.title: Your Data Stays Yours
privacy.subtitle: We take privacy seriously. Here's our commitment to you.

noTracking.title: No Tracking
noTracking.description: We don't use analytics, cookies, or any tracking tools. Your browsing habits are yours alone.

noAds.title: No Ads
noAds.description: Zero advertising. Our mission is to serve you, not advertisers. Support us directly if you want.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliant
gdpr.description: Operated from France with full GDPR compliance. Your data rights are protected by law.

sources.title: Trusted Sources
sources.subtitle: Aggregating content from leading tech publications, blogs, and news outlets.

footer.copyright: FeedCentral. Open source RSS aggregator built with Next.js.
footer.tagline: Operated from France • GDPR Compliant • No tracking, no ads, no BS

notice.title: This is a Hobby Project
notice.description: FeedCentral was built for fun because I wanted a single place to read my news without the bullshit from social media or TV fake news. I work on this when I have time and feel like it.
notice.disclaimer: The features listed below are just ideas I've had. They may or may not be implemented. There's no timeline, no commitments, and no guarantees. I'll add stuff when (and if) I want to.
notice.opensource: If you want something specific, fork the project and build it yourself! It's open source for a reason.

idea.title: Got an idea?
idea.description: Feel free to open an issue on
idea.disclaimer: but remember: this is a hobby project. I might love your idea, or I might not have time to work on it. If you really want it, submit a PR!

support.title: Want to Support This Project?
support.description: The best way to support FeedCentral is to:
support.use: Use it and share it with others who hate fake news
support.star: Star the repo on GitHub if you find it useful
support.bugs: Report bugs when you find them
support.contribute: Contribute code if you're a developer
support.sources: Tell me what RSS sources you'd like to see added
support.patreon: If you really want to throw money at this hobby project, I have a
support.enough: But honestly, just using FeedCentral and sharing feedback is more than enough!
